primary_result: The frozen ITS and OTS planned rosters and all 300 canonical clear-scene identities were reproduced exactly, but none of the three predeclared hazy roots existed at runtime. The route therefore found zero paired scenes and cannot establish the nested haze-pairing or formation/content contract needed to author revised S1.
gate_reasons: The S1 v1 and S0 parent identities, typed terminal tuples, S0 ledger SHA-256, and exact ITS/OTS development capacities all matched the frozen evidence contract.
The original S1 v1 scene-selection salt reproduced the exact parent planned-scene digests for 150 ITS and 150 OTS scenes with no backfill.
All 300 planned clear images were present, decoded, and matched their S0 canonical RGB identities; scoring geometry was valid for all 300 scenes.

The ITS train, ITS validation, and OTS predeclared hazy roots were all unavailable, yielding zero haze files, zero paired scenes, and invalid downstream precision and resource-feasibility interpretation.
The run completed all 3 generic workload units and produced a 300-row SHA-bound mapping ledger without model, checkpoint, inference, restoration-outcome, confirmation, or sealed-final access.
competing_explanation: The parent S1 coverage veto was caused by absent or incorrectly specified hazy dataset roots rather than drift in the original planned roster, S0 canonical clear-scene identity, clear-image dimensions, or scoring-crop geometry.
limitations: No haze payload was found or decoded, so the route provides no evidence that any planned scene has two distinct formation observations.

The observed clear-image shape bounds do not by themselves qualify the exact full-image ConvIR-B production path; whole-image resource feasibility remains invalid until pairing validity is complete and a matching device-aware capability contract is authored.
The terminal is a measurement-validity INCONCLUSIVE, not a scientific FAIL and not evidence for or against local restoration need, local-over-global utility, near-clear safety, or S2 readiness.
Only further outcome-blind dataset-path, identity, or pairing evidence review is authorized; revised S1 authoring and execution remain unauthorized.
